profile.headline: Software Developer at Epic
profile.summary:
Specialties:
Enterprise Systems Design, Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Service-Oriented Architecture, Application Performance Optimization, Real-Time Embedded Systems, Computer Graphics

Programming Languages and Technologies:
C#, C/C++, Caché, Java, PHP, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, JQuery, Android Programming, SQL, Microsoft Enterprise Library, OpenGL, Windows Store App Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designs, develops and maintains professional billing application in the larger Epic's integrated healthcare system
- Performs root cause analysis for potential system issues
- Performs peer code reviews and analyses

positions.title: Senior Application Consultant
positions.description:
- Architect and Doctor Module Lead of Electronic Inpatient Medication Record and Inpatient Medication Administration Record System (eIMR-iMAR) that is being used in four major hospitals in Singapore

- Identifies and performs root cause analysis in application performance and security issues

- Designed and implemented an ASP.NET Web Forms MVP based Drug Regimen ordering system for cancer patients

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Involved in a new-product development team to develop a high-performance online entertainment website using ASP.NET, MS SQL, AJAX and JavaScript

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Research concerns a location-based Android app for real-time route and traffic estimation in Singapore through crowd-sourcing

- Designed the spatiotemporal database for handling and storage of user-contributed GPS traces

- Devised the backend algorithm of route and traffic estimation for the app

- Implemented the front-end Web UI for traffic data analysis using PHP and Google Map API

company.name: Computer Networks & Distributed Systems Lab, NUS

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Research concerns the usage of a type of artificial neural network (ANN) called Self-Organizing Map (SOM) in the area of knowledge discovery and information retrieval

- Implemented a text-document clustering system using a hierarchical, incremental and growing SOM

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Responsible for the full life-cycle development of an online timesheet management system using ASP.NET and MS SQL
